title: Best Keywords to Target with Google Ads for Massage  - Scaling Wellness

facts.fact: Scaling Wellness recommends that massage businesses add the negative keywords "free", "school", "DIY", "how to", "salary", "jobs", "at home", and "massage gun" to keep ads from showing for irrelevant searches.
facts.quote: Here are some negative keywords most massage businesses should add: "free" "school" "DIY" "how to" "salary" "jobs" "at home" "massage gun"

facts.fact: Scaling Wellness states that bidding on competitor business names often leads to low conversion and click fraud, unless the advertiser has a specific legal strategy or brand awareness play.
facts.quote: Unless you have a specific legal strategy or brand awareness play, bidding on competitor business names often leads to low conversion and click fraud.

facts.fact: Scaling Wellness groups suggested massage keywords by client goal, listing "back pain massage", "neck pain massage", and "sciatica relief massage" under Pain Relief, and "prenatal massage" and "pregnancy massage therapist" under Pregnancy.
facts.quote: Pain Relief back pain massage, neck pain massage, sciatica relief massage Relaxation stress relief massage, relaxing massage near me, aromatherapy massage
